fullText.simplified:
第十一章、梦醒

    时间一天天过去，阿意一天天老去。
    到了第六十二天，阿意已经老得不能走路了。
    这天早上，阿意睡在床上，看着满院子的花，幸福地睡着了。她再也不会醒来了。戴利坐在床边，看着阿意，难过地大哭起来。他哭得很伤心，越哭越大声。最伤心的时候，他的眼前一黑，倒在了床边。
    是睡着了吗？好像是的。
    不知道过了多久，戴利醒了。
    “阿利，阿利！你终于醒了！”一个女人的声音哭着说。
    戴利看向她，是妈妈——是戴利的妈妈！他再看了看，发现他睡在自己的房间里，戴利吃惊极了。
    “妈妈，这是哪儿？我回来了吗？你为什么哭？”戴利问。
    妈妈哭着说：“孩子，这是你的房间啊！你睡了六十二天，一直不醒！我每天在你的床边叫你，你听到没有？”
    睡了六十二天？戴利吃惊得说不出话了。他只是睡了一觉吗？会古市和阿意，还有他和阿意的孩子，不是真的吗？只是一场梦吗？
    妈妈还在哭，戴利说：“妈妈，你别难过，我已经回来了。”
    这时候，爸爸进来了，哥哥进来了，妹妹也进来了。大家看到戴利醒了，都激动地抱着戴利高兴地笑了。戴利也抱着他们，像是抱着六十多年没见的家人。
    妈妈还有点儿不放心，她请来医生。医生给戴利看了看，对大家说：“虽然阿利睡了两个月，但他没事，身体很好，大家可以放心了。”
    就这样，戴利回到了自己的家。
    生活又回到了以前的样子，戴利好像只是睡了一觉，做了一个梦。但戴利知道，自己和以前不一样了。他相信那个梦是真的，他很想再回到梦里。
    戴利不看书了，他总是睡觉。因为只有睡觉，才能做梦。他希望睡着以后能做梦，梦里能回到会古市。他不但晚上睡，而且白天也睡。从早睡到晚，从晚睡到早。他睡了很多觉，做了很多梦，但没有一个梦是关于会古市的。
    两个多月过去了，夏天到了。戴利越来越着急，也越来越难过。他还能再回到会古市吗？
fullText.traditional:
第十一章、夢醒

    時間一天天過去，阿意一天天老去。
    到了第六十二天，阿意已經老得不能走路了。
    這天早上，阿意睡在床上，看著滿院子的花，幸福地睡著了。她再也不會醒來了。戴利坐在床邊，看著阿意，難過地大哭起來。他哭得很傷心，越哭越大聲。最傷心的時候，他的眼前一黑，倒在了床邊。
    是睡著了嗎？好像是的。
    不知道過了多久，戴利醒了。
    “阿利，阿利！你終於醒了！”一個女人的聲音哭著說。
    戴利看向她，是媽媽——是戴利的媽媽！他再看了看，發現他睡在自己的房間裡，戴利吃驚極了。
    “媽媽，這是哪兒？我回來了嗎？你為什麼哭？”戴利問。
    媽媽哭著說：“孩子，這是你的房間啊！你睡了六十二天，一直不醒！我每天在你的床邊叫你，你聽到沒有？”
    睡了六十二天？戴利吃驚得說不出話了。他只是睡了一覺嗎？會古市和阿意，還有他和阿意的孩子，不是真的嗎？只是一場夢嗎？
    媽媽還在哭，戴利說：“媽媽，你別難過，我已經回來了。”
    這時候，爸爸進來了，哥哥進來了，妹妹也進來了。大家看到戴利醒了，都激動地抱著戴利高興地笑了。戴利也抱著他們，像是抱著六十多年沒見的家人。
    媽媽還有點兒不放心，她請來醫生。醫生給戴利看了看，對大家說：“雖然阿利睡了兩個月，但他沒事，身體很好，大家可以放心了。”
    就這樣，戴利回到了自己的家。
    生活又回到了以前的樣子，戴利好像只是睡了一覺，做了一個夢。但戴利知道，自己和以前不一樣了。他相信那個夢是真的，他很想再回到夢裡。
    戴利不看書了，他總是睡覺。因為只有睡覺，才能做夢。他希望睡著以後能做夢，夢裡能回到會古市。他不但晚上睡，而且白天也睡。從早睡到晚，從晚睡到早。他睡了很多覺，做了很多夢，但沒有一個夢是關於會古市的。
    兩個多月過去了，夏天到了。戴利越來越著急，也越來越難過。他還能再回到會古市嗎？

sentences.traditional: 時間一天天過去，阿意一天天老去。

sentences.simplified: 到了第六十二天，阿意已经老得不能走路了。
sentences.traditional: 到了第六十二天，阿意已經老得不能走路了。
sentences.pinyin: dào le dì liù shí èr tiān ā yì yǐ jīng lǎo de bù néng zǒu lù le
sentences.english: On the 62nd day, Ah Yi was so old she could no longer walk.

sentences.simplified: 这天早上，阿意睡在床上，看着满院子的花，幸福地睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 這天早上，阿意睡在床上，看著滿院子的花，幸福地睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān zǎo shang ā yì shuì zài chuáng shang kàn zhe mǎn yuàn zi de huā xìng fú de shuì zháo le
sentences.english: That morning, Ah Yi lay in bed and looked at the courtyard filled with flowers. She happily fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 她再也不会醒来了。戴利坐在床边，看着阿意，难过地大哭起来。
sentences.traditional: 她再也不會醒來了。戴利坐在床邊，看著阿意，難過地大哭起來。

sentences.english: She would not wake up again. Dai Li sat by the bed and looked at Ah Yi. He began to cry loudly with sadness.

sentences.simplified: 他哭得很伤心，越哭越大声。
sentences.traditional: 他哭得很傷心，越哭越大聲。
sentences.pinyin: tā kū de hěn shāng xīn yuè kū yuè dà shēng
sentences.english: He cried out in grief. The more he cried, the louder he became.

sentences.simplified: 最伤心的时候，他的眼前一黑，倒在了床边。
sentences.traditional: 最傷心的時候，他的眼前一黑，倒在了床邊。
sentences.pinyin: zuì shāng xīn de shí hou tā de yǎn qián yì hēi dǎo zài le chuáng biān
sentences.english: When he was most broken-hearted, he saw black and collapsed by the bed.

sentences.simplified: 是睡着了吗？好像是的。
sentences.traditional: 是睡著了嗎？好像是的。
sentences.pinyin: shì shuì zháo le ma hǎo xiàng shì de
sentences.english: Had he fallen asleep? It seemed like it.

sentences.simplified: 不知道过了多久，戴利醒了。
sentences.traditional: 不知道過了多久，戴利醒了。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào guò le duō jiǔ dài lì xǐng le
sentences.english: An unknown amount of time passed, and Dai Li woke up.

sentences.simplified: “阿利，阿利！你终于醒了！”一个女人的声音哭着说。
sentences.traditional: “阿利，阿利！你終於醒了！”一個女人的聲音哭著說。
sentences.pinyin: ā lì ā lì nǐ zhōng yú xǐng le yí ge nǚ rén de shēng yīn kū zhe shuō
sentences.english: “Ah Li, Ah Li! You’ve finally woken up!” A woman’s voice said in tears.

sentences.simplified: 戴利看向她，是妈妈——是戴利的妈妈！
sentences.traditional: 戴利看向她，是媽媽——是戴利的媽媽！

sentences.english: Dai Li looked toward her. It was Mom. It was Dai Li’s mom!

sentences.simplified: 他再看了看，发现他睡在自己的房间里，戴利吃惊极了。
sentences.traditional: 他再看了看，發現他睡在自己的房間裡，戴利吃驚極了。

sentences.simplified: “妈妈，这是哪儿？我回来了吗？你为什么哭？”戴利问。
sentences.traditional: “媽媽，這是哪兒？我回來了嗎？你為什麼哭？”戴利問。

sentences.english: “Mom, where is this? Have I come back? Why are you crying?” Dai Li asked.

sentences.traditional: 媽媽哭著說：“孩子，這是你的房間啊！
sentences.pinyin: mā ma kū zhe shuō hái zi zhè shì nǐ de fáng jiān a
sentences.english: Mom cried as she said, “Child, this is your room!

sentences.traditional: 你睡了六十二天，一直不醒！我每天在你的床邊叫你，你聽到沒有？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shuì le liù shí èr tiān yì zhí bù xǐng wǒ měi tiān zài nǐ de chuáng biān jiào nǐ nǐ tīng dào méi yǒu
sentences.english: You slept for 62 days and never woke up! Every day I was beside your bed calling you. Did you hear?”

sentences.simplified: 睡了六十二天？戴利吃惊得说不出话了。他只是睡了一觉吗？
sentences.traditional: 睡了六十二天？戴利吃驚得說不出話了。他只是睡了一覺嗎？
sentences.pinyin: shuì le liù shí èr tiān dài lì chī jīng de shuō bù chū huà le tā zhǐ shì shuì le yí jiào ma
sentences.english: Slept for 62 days? Dai Li was so taken aback he couldn’t speak. Had he just been asleep?

sentences.simplified: 会古市和阿意，还有他和阿意的孩子，不是真的吗？只是一场梦吗？
sentences.traditional: 會古市和阿意，還有他和阿意的孩子，不是真的嗎？只是一場夢嗎？
sentences.pinyin: huì gǔ shì hé ā yì hái yǒu tā hé ā yì de hái zi bú shì zhēn de ma zhǐ shì yì cháng mèng ma
sentences.english: Huigu City and Ah Yi, and also him and Ah Yi’s child, were not real? They were only a dream?

sentences.simplified: 妈妈还在哭，戴利说：“妈妈，你别难过，我已经回来了。”
sentences.traditional: 媽媽還在哭，戴利說：“媽媽，你別難過，我已經回來了。”
sentences.pinyin: mā ma hái zài kū dài lì shuō mā ma nǐ bié nán guò wǒ yǐ jīng huí lái le
sentences.english: Mom was still crying. Dai Li said, “Mom, don’t be sad. I have come back.”

sentences.simplified: 这时候，爸爸进来了，哥哥进来了，妹妹也进来了。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，爸爸進來了，哥哥進來了，妹妹也進來了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou bà ba jìn lái le gē ge jìn lái le mèi mei yě jìn lái le
sentences.english: At this time, his dad came in, his elder brother came in, and his younger sister also came in.

sentences.simplified: 大家看到戴利醒了，都激动地抱着戴利高兴地笑了。
sentences.traditional: 大家看到戴利醒了，都激動地抱著戴利高興地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā kàn dào dài lì xǐng le dōu jī dòng de bào zhe dài lì gāo xìng de xiào le
sentences.english: Everyone saw that Dai Li had woken up and were emotional. They embraced Dai Li and smiled happily.

sentences.simplified: 戴利也抱着他们，像是抱着六十多年没见的家人。
sentences.traditional: 戴利也抱著他們，像是抱著六十多年沒見的家人。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì yě bào zhe tā men xiàng shì bào zhe liù shí duō nián méi jiàn de jiā rén
sentences.english: Dai Li also embraced them, like he was embracing family members he hadn’t seen in more than 60 years.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈还有点儿不放心，她请来医生。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽還有點兒不放心，她請來醫生。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma hái yǒu diǎn'r bú fàng xīn tā qǐng lái yī shēng
sentences.english: Mom was still a little worried and asked a doctor to come around.

sentences.simplified: 医生给戴利看了看，对大家说：
sentences.traditional: 醫生給戴利看了看，對大家說：
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng gěi dài lì kàn le kàn duì dà jiā shuō
sentences.english: The doctor looked over Dai Li and said to everyone, ..

sentences.simplified: “虽然阿利睡了两个月，但他没事，身体很好，大家可以放心了。”
sentences.traditional: “雖然阿利睡了兩個月，但他沒事，身體很好，大家可以放心了。”
sentences.pinyin: suī rán ā lì shuì le liǎng ge yuè dàn tā méi shì shēn tǐ hěn hǎo dà jiā kě yǐ fàng xīn le
sentences.english: .. “Although Ah Li has been sleeping for two months, he is fine. His health is good. Everyone can relax.”

sentences.simplified: 就这样，戴利回到了自己的家。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，戴利回到了自己的家。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng dài lì huí dào le zì jǐ de jiā
sentences.english: Just like that, Dai Li returned to his own home.

sentences.simplified: 生活又回到了以前的样子，戴利好像只是睡了一觉，做了一个梦。
sentences.traditional: 生活又回到了以前的樣子，戴利好像只是睡了一覺，做了一個夢。
sentences.pinyin: shēng huó yòu huí dào le yǐ qián de yàng zi dài lì hǎo xiàng zhǐ shì shuì le yí jiào zuò le yí ge mèng
sentences.english: Life also returned to the way it used to be. It was as if Dai Li had just been sleeping and had a dream.

sentences.simplified: 但戴利知道，自己和以前不一样了。
sentences.traditional: 但戴利知道，自己和以前不一樣了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dài lì zhī dào zì jǐ hé yǐ qián bù yí yàng le
sentences.english: But Dai Li knew that he was not the same as he used to be.

sentences.simplified: 他相信那个梦是真的，他很想再回到梦里。
sentences.traditional: 他相信那個夢是真的，他很想再回到夢裡。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiāng xìn nà ge mèng shì zhēn de tā hěn xiǎng zài huí dào mèng lǐ
sentences.english: He believed that dream was real. He really wanted to go back inside the dream.

sentences.simplified: 戴利不看书了，他总是睡觉。因为只有睡觉，才能做梦。
sentences.traditional: 戴利不看書了，他總是睡覺。因為只有睡覺，才能做夢。
sentences.pinyin: dài lì bú kàn shū le tā zǒng shì shuì jiào yīn wèi zhǐ yǒu shuì jiào cái néng zuò mèng
sentences.english: Dai Li no longer read. He was always sleeping. Because only by sleeping could he dream.

sentences.simplified: 他希望睡着以后能做梦，梦里能回到会古市。
sentences.traditional: 他希望睡著以後能做夢，夢裡能回到會古市。
sentences.pinyin: tā xī wàng shuì zháo yǐ hòu néng zuò mèng mèng lǐ néng huí dào huì gǔ shì
sentences.english: He hoped that after falling asleep, he could dream, and in his dreams, he could return to Huigu City.

sentences.simplified: 他不但晚上睡，而且白天也睡。从早睡到晚，从晚睡到早。
sentences.traditional: 他不但晚上睡，而且白天也睡。從早睡到晚，從晚睡到早。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú dàn wǎn shang shuì ér qiě bái tiān yě shuì cóng zǎo shuì dào wǎn cóng wǎn shuì dào zǎo
sentences.english: He not only slept at night; he also slept during the day. He slept from morning until night and from night until morning.

sentences.simplified: 他睡了很多觉，做了很多梦，但没有一个梦是关于会古市的。
sentences.traditional: 他睡了很多覺，做了很多夢，但沒有一個夢是關於會古市的。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuì le hěn duō jiào zuò le hěn duō mèng dàn méi yǒu yí ge mèng shì guān yú huì gǔ shì de
sentences.english: He slept a lot and dreamed a lot, but not a single dream was about Huigu City.

sentences.simplified: 两个多月过去了，夏天到了。戴利越来越着急，也越来越难过。
sentences.traditional: 兩個多月過去了，夏天到了。戴利越來越著急，也越來越難過。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge duō yuè guò qù le xià tiān dào le dài lì yuè lái yuè zháo jí yě yuè lái yuè nán guò
sentences.english: Two months passed, and summer arrived. Dai Li became more and more anxious and also more and more sad.

sentences.simplified: 他还能再回到会古市吗？
sentences.traditional: 他還能再回到會古市嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā hái néng zài huí dào huì gǔ shì ma
sentences.english: Would he be able to return to Huigu City again?

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: Waking From the Dream
Time passed day by day. Ah Yi grew older with each day.
On the 62nd day, Ah Yi was so old she could no longer walk.
That morning, Ah Yi lay in bed and looked at the courtyard filled with flowers. She happily fell asleep.
She would not wake up again. Dai Li sat by the bed and looked at Ah Yi. He began to cry loudly with sadness.
He cried out in grief. The more he cried, the louder he became.
When he was most broken-hearted, he saw black and collapsed by the bed.
Had he fallen asleep? It seemed like it.
An unknown amount of time passed, and Dai Li woke up.
“Ah Li, Ah Li! You’ve finally woken up!” A woman’s voice said in tears.
Dai Li looked toward her. It was Mom. It was Dai Li’s mom!
He looked again and discovered he was lying in his own bedroom. Dai Li was taken aback.
“Mom, where is this? Have I come back? Why are you crying?” Dai Li asked.
Mom cried as she said, “Child, this is your room!
You slept for 62 days and never woke up! Every day I was beside your bed calling you. Did you hear?”
Slept for 62 days? Dai Li was so taken aback he couldn’t speak. Had he just been asleep?
Huigu City and Ah Yi, and also him and Ah Yi’s child, were not real? They were only a dream?
Mom was still crying. Dai Li said, “Mom, don’t be sad. I have come back.”
At this time, his dad came in, his elder brother came in, and his younger sister also came in.
Everyone saw that Dai Li had woken up and were emotional. They embraced Dai Li and smiled happily.
Dai Li also embraced them, like he was embracing family members he hadn’t seen in more than 60 years.
Mom was still a little worried and asked a doctor to come around.
The doctor looked over Dai Li and said to everyone, ..
.. “Although Ah Li has been sleeping for two months, he is fine. His health is good. Everyone can relax.”
Just like that, Dai Li returned to his own home.
Life also returned to the way it used to be. It was as if Dai Li had just been sleeping and had a dream.
But Dai Li knew that he was not the same as he used to be.
He believed that dream was real. He really wanted to go back inside the dream.
Dai Li no longer read. He was always sleeping. Because only by sleeping could he dream.
He hoped that after falling asleep, he could dream, and in his dreams, he could return to Huigu City.
He not only slept at night; he also slept during the day. He slept from morning until night and from night until morning.
He slept a lot and dreamed a lot, but not a single dream was about Huigu City.
Two months passed, and summer arrived. Dai Li became more and more anxious and also more and more sad.
Would he be able to return to Huigu City again?
